Conflict card for developer

Concrete input: low_battery is true and emergency_stop is true on line_1.

Rule A - Send a low-battery robot to its dock - triggers on this input and requires action dock.

Rule B - An emergency stop requires the robot to halt - triggers on this input and requires action halt.

The actions are incompatible: dock and halt cannot both be done.

Which rule wins for this input?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
